title: Photo shoot in Seville
text: My husband, oldest son and I arranged  a photo session with Fran in Seville on my birthday.  This was set up via Local Photographer.  Fran took us to Plaza de Espana for a fun photo shoot. He was very professional, easy to work with and we enjoyed being with him.  The place is beautiful and there are lots of wonderful spots for pictures. The photos came out great and we now have a wonderful memory of our time spent in Seville. Highly recommend!
author: lr00t
